overall_goal: Clean the kitchen counters, transfer cooked food to a bowl, and wash up

goals.description: Wipe the kitchen counters with a napkin
goals.rationale: The person picks up a rag or napkin and uses it to wipe down multiple counter surfaces.

goals.description: Stir the food and transfer it from the saucepan to a bowl
goals.rationale: The person stirs the contents of the saucepan, turns off the hob, and scoops the food into a green bowl.

goals.description: Wet the sponge and wipe the counter around the hob
goals.rationale: The person places the empty saucepan in the sink, wets a sponge, and wipes the counter surface near the hob.

goals.description: Turn off the timer and dry hands
goals.rationale: The person turns off a timer, rinses the sponge in the sink, and dries their hands on a towel.
